verdict.rationale: Inngest documents a REST API for events, function runs, environments "and more". A CLI can inspect runs, fetch traces and invoke functions, and an official MCP server lets agents inspect and operate Inngest, so substantial programmatic coverage exists. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed inngest.com paths. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or demonstration that every dashboard action (e.g. webhook creation, AI Overview/evals views, environment and settings management) is available via the API, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.
